 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Boston Celtics are at home Tuesday night as they host the Brooklyn Nets in an Eastern Conference matchup.
 Boston enters Tuesday's game with a 2-1 record after defeating the Chicago Bulls at home in dominant fashion Monday night.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Boston Celtics forward Jayson Tatum (0).Brian Fluharty-Imagn Images
 In Monday's victory, Jayson Tatum led the way for the Celtics as he recorded 23 points, seven rebounds and six assists while Payton Pritchard added 28 points and four assists of his own off the bench.
 The Celtics will try to grab another victory Tuesday as they face off against a struggling Nets team at home.
 Brooklyn enters Tuesday's contest with an 0-3 record after losing at home to the Indiana Pacers Sunday night.
 Brooklyn Nets guard Nolan Traore (88)Jerome Miron-Imagn Images
 Nolan Traore led the way for the Nets in Sunday's loss as he ended the game with 17 points and five assists off the bench while Josh Minott recorded 15 points and eight rebounds off the bench.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement While both teams are looking to pick up a victory in Tuesday night's matchup, one may be without one of their key players due to injury.
 Nets Injury Report
 The Nets enter Tuesday's contest with a healthy roster as they have nobody listed on their injury report other than those assigned to the G League.
 Celtics Injury Report: Will Derrick White Play?
 Boston Celtics guard Derrick White (9) © Troy Taormina-Imagn Images
 The Celtics have two players listed on their injury report for Tuesday, including guard Derrick White.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Boston has listed White as probable due to right hip synovitis and he is expected to play against the Nets.
 The Celtics have ruled out Devin Carter due to an illness as he will miss his fourth consecutive contest to begin the season.
 Fans can catch Tuesday night's matchup between the Nets and Celtics from TD Garden at 7:30 p.m. ET.
